query:
query ClimbStatsForClimbs($boardName: String!, $climbUuids: [ID!]!) {
    climbStatsForClimbs(boardName: $boardName, climbUuids: $climbUuids) {
      climbUuid
      angle
      ascensionistCount
      qualityAverage
      difficultyAverage
      displayDifficulty
      difficulty
      faUsername
      faAt
      syncSeq
    }
  }
